$comment: The domain kernel's own typecheck baseline — the repository's strict flags plus one deliberate tightening: `types: []` means no ambient Node globals exist here, so `process`, `Buffer`, `__dirname` and friends are compile errors inside the kernel, not style violations. Purity layering is recorded in docs/adr/0001-domain-kernel-and-semantic-version.md: this layer catches the globals archkeep's import analysis cannot see, while archkeep (`bannedExternalImports`) owns the imports themselves.
